channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Hide and Moo!
item.description: Somewhere in this field, someone is doing their best animal impression. It’s you. Record your own animal sound, then try to match it under pressure while hunters close in. A chaotic voice-mimicry hide-and-seek party game with proximity chat.

item.title: Imperial Knights
item.description: Become an imperial knight to reclaim your family's honor and discover what drove your sister to abandon her country!

item.title: Package chaos
item.description: Package Chaos is a cozy package sorting game where you turn a messy warehouse into a perfectly organized delivery center. Pick up, inspect, sort thousands of unique packages and enjoy the satisfying feeling of a perfectly organized warehouse.

item.title: Resort Island Simulator
item.description: A world filled with tricksters, pirates, zealots, and treasures. An ocean full of danger and prize. Face dilemmas and encounters. Manage a resort in this wild world and build a thriving business. An Explorer, a Survivor a Resorter or a Trader? Forge your own path to wealth. Make Resort Prosper!

item.title: Spellmasons - Runesmith
item.description: Customize your spells with Augments, survive a variety of challenge rooms, and specialize your magic in entirely new ways in Spellmasons: Runesmith!

item.title: Star Valor - Base Building
item.description: Build and manage your own stations, with a wide variety of bases and modules to improve your galactic empire. This expansions also adds a new 'station defense' game mode, a new ship role as well as ship models.

item.title: Vampire Survivors: Emergency Meeting
item.description: Gather your Crewmates, eject Impostors, and be the bullet hell in Vampire Survivors: Emergency Meeting.

item.title: Vampire Survivors: Tides of the Foscari
item.description: A fighter, a mage, and a thief enter a forest: a quest. Explore a surprising new forest, called Lake, and wield incredible new weapons, like the sword, the arrow, and the magic, in this fantasy based on fantasy. Mow down thousands of enemies for glory and treasure once again, in Tides of the Foscari

item.title: A Little Age
item.description: A cozy minimalist city builder about expanding a network of settlements, each with its own little economy. Manage the flow of resources between them at your own pace, and pause at any time. Watch a civilization emerge as your settlements work together to raise a great temple and claim the land.

item.title: Alice's Gaze
item.description: "Alice's Gaze" is a dark fairy-tale clicker and idle game. Accompany Alice as she awakens in a strange mansion, gaze upon the cat god's altar, delve into the abyss of terror, revive the slumbering rooms one by one, and search for a way to escape.

item.title: Allumeria
item.description: A classic voxel sandbox combined with in-depth progression through exploration, dungeon crawling and boss battles. Spend every minute discovering new weapons, abilities, resources, enemies, structures, mechanics and tools. With a strong focus on discovery, variety and creativity, the world is yours.

item.title: Astronomics
item.description: Welcome to the asteroid belt. The work is dangerous, the asteroids are temporary, and Earth is prohibitively expensive. Build automated mining operations, complete contracts, and earn your way back home.

item.title: Board Game Society
item.description: Board Game Society is a turn-based RPG soaked in 80s VHS horror vibes. Play as a misfit crew of teen archetypes such as the goth, the jock, the nerd, and more as you explore the cursed forest of Timber Falls. Roll the dice to fight monsters, collect loot, and race to defeat the Boss.

item.title: Click and Conquer
item.description: Click and Conquer is a short, relaxing incremental game. Drop bombs through the fog of war, uncover hidden enemies, collect rewards, and spend currency to boost passive income, increase bombing power, and unlock new maps.

item.title: Divinum
item.description: Divinum is an action-adventure that blends stylish, expressive combat with rewarding exploration. Master devastating combos and craft unique builds to repel mysterious invaders and uncover your island's hidden truth.

item.title: House 2
item.description: As a terrible storm rages on, a young girl tries to survive in a HOUSE hell-bent on killing her and her family...

item.title: Inferno Protocol
item.description: A survival horror set in a massive maze. Play solo or 6-player co-op. Scavenge resources to craft gear and survive against terrifying enemies. Unlock unique abilities and find the exit.

item.title: Mall Rivals
item.description: Competitive mall simulation. 1-8 players open stores in the same mall, fight for customers, crush rivals. Team up or go solo. Fair play or dirty tricks? Your call. Procedural maps, employee system,mall cops, smugglers and physical mechanics.

item.title: Reality Break
item.description: Rewrite the universe! Break reality to change your fate, and use your powers to stop sinister forces from altering existence itself. Discover the origin of your new abilities in a fast-paced ARPG Loot Collection Roguelite where you will bend, break, and change the laws of the universe!

item.title: Spellmasons
item.description: Spellmasons is a magical, tactical roguelike where you customize your spells. Play solo or team up with your friends in online multiplayer, and explore a deep magic system where clever combinations yield powerfully satisfying results!

item.title: Star Valor
item.description: Choose your own destiny as you explore an open-world procedurally generated galaxy where anything is possible. Become a miner, a trader, a bounty hunter, a pirate, or perhaps a jack of all trades. Start off small and build your way to the top but remember with every action, comes consequences.

item.title: Star Vortex
item.description: Star Vortex is a fast-paced Action-RPG inspired by classics of the genre. Design your ship, fight through hostile alien sectors solo or with friends, salvage rare weapons and experiment with powerful builds until nothing can stand against you.

item.title: The Economy Bros
item.description: Build your dream city from scratch in this sandbox tycoon: start by working or gathering resources, trade businesses and real estate based on market demand, expand your land, and grow your empire—all while surviving and stacking up cold hard cash from your strategic moves.

item.title: UFO 50
item.description: UFO 50 is a collection of 50 single and multiplayer games that span a variety of genres, from platformers and shoot 'em ups to puzzle games, roguelites, and RPGs. Our goal is to combine a familiar 8-bit aesthetic with new ideas and modern game design.

item.title: Vampire Survivors Soundtrack
item.description: The Vampire Survivors Soundtrack currently contains 50 music tracks from the main game and DLC, and 8 jingles, including the Treasure Opening ones, for a total of 58 MP3 files, at 320kpbp.

item.title: WakuWaku Park
item.description: Miki wakes up in a park on a summer morning, with shadowy men in black closing in. To survive, she must run, drink, and evade the shadows closing in.

item.title: Garden of Witches
item.description: Garden of Witches is a cute roguelike action game full of danger. Help the protagonist, Sil, as she tries to round up her unruly fellow witches and save the Garden.

item.title: Just Keep Fishing
item.description: A short incremental game about catching a lot of fish🎣

item.title: Last Breath 最后的气息
item.description: Last Breath is a tense side-scrolling shooter in a fungal-ravaged world, where humanity has become “Spore Zombies.” As the older sister Guan Jin, fight through the ruins to find your lost sibling. Scavenge, adapt, survive. But what awaits: redemption or a deeper nightmare?

item.title: Shadows Over Loathing
item.description: Shadows over Loathing — a slapstick-figure comedy adventure-RPG full of mobsters, monsters, and mysteries.

item.title: Smack Talk
item.description: Say your moves out loud, trash-talk your friends, and fight to win. Smack Talk is a 1–8 player online PvP platform fighter where your voice controls your attacks. Call moves, land one-liners, and finish foes with wild ultimates.

item.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator Suite: Themes Reimagined
item.description: Fully immerse yourself in the world of flight with this digital soundtrack to accompany you on your aviation journey. This suite of 21 unreleased original pieces is inspired by popular trailer scores created by Finishing Move Inc. for Microsoft Flight Simulator.
